objective_pt: Contar o que outra pessoa disse, pediu ou perguntou ("She told me...", "He asked if...") numa conversa natural.

teacher.goal_pt: Puxar fofocas leves e recados para ver como o aluno reporta falas.
prompts: What did your boss say in your last meeting?
Has anyone given you good news recently? What did they say?
watchFor: Dizer "she said me"; com pessoa é "she told me" ou "she said to me".
Manter o tempo verbal original sem necessidade quando o contexto já é passado (aceitável na fala, mas observar).

exercises.prompt: She told me she was leaving the company next month.
accepted: She told me she was leaving the company next month.
She told me that she was leaving the company next month.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Say" não leva a pessoa direto. Use "told me" ou "said to me".
commonErrors.correction_en: She told me she was leaving the company next month.

options: He told me he was tired.
He said me he was tired.
He told that he was tired.
exercises.explanation_pt: "Tell" precisa da pessoa ("told me"). "Say" funciona sem a pessoa ("he said he was tired").

exercises.instruction_pt: Say it in English: "Ele me disse que estava ocupado."
accepted: He told me he was busy
He told me that he was busy
He said he was busy
He said that he was busy
He said to me that he was busy
He said to me he was busy

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Say" não aceita a pessoa direto. Diga "He told me" ou "He said".
commonErrors.correction_en: He told me he was busy.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Tell" precisa dizer para quem: "He told me that...". Sem a pessoa, use "said".
commonErrors.correction_en: He told me he was busy.

teacher.goal_pt: Aprender verbos de relato além de "say" e "tell": mention, explain, ask, warn, admit, promise, suggest.
prompts: Did anyone warn you about something recently?
What did your friend suggest last time you asked for advice?
watchFor: Dizer "he suggested me to go"; o natural é "he suggested (that) I go" ou "he suggested going".

exercises.example_en: She mentioned that the office would be closed on Friday.
He warned me not to take the highway at rush hour.
She admitted that she had forgotten the meeting.

exercises.instruction_pt: Match each verb to its meaning.
Say it in English: "Ela me lembrou de ligar para o cliente."
accepted: She reminded me to call the client
She reminded me to call the customer
She reminded me to phone the client
She reminded me that I had to call the client
She reminded me I needed to call the client
She reminded me to give the client a call

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Remember" é lembrar você mesmo. Para fazer outra pessoa lembrar, use "remind": "She reminded me to...".
commonErrors.correction_en: She reminded me to call the client.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Para uma tarefa, use "remind someone to do something": "reminded me to call".
commonErrors.correction_en: She reminded me to call the client.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Ligar para" alguém é "call someone", sem preposição.
commonErrors.correction_en: She reminded me to call the client.

teacher.goal_pt: Treinar a fala encadeada em "told me", "asked if" e "said that" (o "that" fraco).
prompts: Say "he asked if" quickly. Does it sound like one word?
How do you say "that" in "she said that"?
watchFor: Pronunciar o "that" de relato com força; ele fica fraco ("thət").

exercises.prompt: She asked if I could stay a bit longer.
accepted: She asked if I could stay a bit longer.
She asked whether I could stay a bit longer.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Em pergunta reportada não há inversão: "asked if I could".
commonErrors.correction_en: She asked if I could stay a bit longer.

exercises.prompt: He said that the train had already left.
accepted: He said that the train had already left.
He said the train had already left.

exercises.explanation_pt: Depois de som sem vibração, como "k", o "-ed" soa "t": "askt".

teacher.goal_pt: Ouvir uma fala direta e repassá-la para outra pessoa com discurso indireto.
prompts: Your colleague left a message. What did she say?
What did the doctor ask you?
watchFor: Manter a ordem de pergunta no relato: "he asked where was the station".
Esquecer de trocar os pronomes ("I" vira "she").

exercises.instruction_pt: Listen to Mark. Then choose the correct report.
exercises.listen: I'll send you the files tomorrow morning.
options: Mark said he would send me the files the next morning.
Mark said I will send you the files tomorrow.
Mark told he sends the files.
exercises.explanation_pt: No relato, "I'll" vira "he would", "you" vira "me", e "tomorrow morning" pode virar "the next morning".

exercises.instruction_pt: Listen to your colleague. Then tell your boss what she said, starting with "She said...".
exercises.listen: I'm stuck in traffic, so I'll be about twenty minutes late.
accepted: She said she was stuck in traffic and she would be about twenty minutes late
She said she was stuck in traffic, so she'd be about twenty minutes late
She said she was stuck in traffic and would be twenty minutes late
She said she's stuck in traffic and she'll be about twenty minutes late
She said she's stuck in traffic, so she'll be twenty minutes late
She said she'd be about twenty minutes late because she was stuck in traffic
She said she would be twenty minutes late because of the traffic
She said she was stuck in traffic
She said she'd be about twenty minutes late
She said she'll be twenty minutes late

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Ao relatar, troque o pronome: o "I" dela vira "she": "She said she was...".
commonErrors.correction_en: She said she was stuck in traffic and would be about twenty minutes late.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Say" não leva a pessoa direto. Use "She told me..." ou "She said...".
commonErrors.correction_en: She told me she was stuck in traffic.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: A expressão é "stuck in traffic", sem "the".
commonErrors.correction_en: She said she was stuck in traffic.

exercises.instruction_pt: Listen to the question. Then report it, starting with "He asked me...".
exercises.listen: Where did you buy that jacket?
accepted: He asked me where I had bought that jacket
He asked me where I bought that jacket
He asked me where I'd bought that jacket
He asked me where I bought my jacket
He asked me where I had bought my jacket
He asked me where I got that jacket
He asked me where I'd got my jacket
He asked me where I bought the jacket

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Na pergunta reportada não há inversão nem "did": "He asked me where I bought...".
commonErrors.correction_en: He asked me where I had bought that jacket.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Ele perguntou sobre você, então "you" vira "I": "where I bought".
commonErrors.correction_en: He asked me where I bought that jacket.

teacher.goal_pt: Contar uma conversa que aconteceu (no trabalho, com um amigo, com o médico) usando vários verbos de relato.
prompts: Tell me about a conversation that surprised you.
What exactly did they say? And what did you answer?
watchFor: Dizer "he asked me if I can" quando o contexto pede "could" (aceitável na fala; comentar se repetir).

exercises.instruction_pt: Say it in English: "Ela me perguntou se eu queria ir à festa."
accepted: She asked me if I wanted to go to the party
She asked me whether I wanted to go to the party
She asked if I wanted to go to the party
She asked whether I wanted to go to the party
She asked me if I wanted to come to the party
She asked me if I'd like to go to the party
She asked me if I wanted to go to the party with her

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Em pergunta reportada, a ordem é de afirmação e sem "did": "asked me if I wanted".
commonErrors.correction_en: She asked me if I wanted to go to the party.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Com "asked" no passado, o verbo da pergunta normalmente também vai para o passado: "if I wanted".
commonErrors.correction_en: She asked me if I wanted to go to the party.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Ask for" é pedir algo. Para perguntar, é "asked me if".
commonErrors.correction_en: She asked me if I wanted to go to the party.

exercises.instruction_pt: Say it in English: "Meu chefe me pediu para terminar o relatório até sexta."
accepted: My boss asked me to finish the report by Friday
My boss told me to finish the report by Friday
My boss asked me to get the report done by Friday
My boss asked me to have the report finished by Friday
My manager asked me to finish the report by Friday
My boss asked me to finish the report before Friday
My boss wants me to finish the report by Friday

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Pedir para alguém fazer algo" é "ask someone to do something": "asked me to finish", sem "for".
commonErrors.correction_en: My boss asked me to finish the report by Friday.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Depois de "asked me" use "to" + verbo: "asked me to finish".
commonErrors.correction_en: My boss asked me to finish the report by Friday.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Até sexta" como prazo é "by Friday". "Until Friday" é algo que continua até sexta.
commonErrors.correction_en: My boss asked me to finish the report by Friday.

accepted: He asked me what time the meeting started

exercises.instruction_pt: Tell your friend about a conversation you had recently. Report what was said and asked.
exercises.prompt_en: You look surprised. What happened? What did they tell you?
guidelines_pt: Report statements: "She told me that...", "He said..."
Report a question: "Then she asked me if..." or "...asked me where..."

teacher.goal_pt: Revisar "say" e "tell", perguntas reportadas e "remind" e "remember".
prompts: What did you tell your family about this course?
What did your teacher ask you last time?

exercises.instruction_pt: Say it in English: "Ele prometeu que ia me ajudar."
accepted: He promised he would help me
He promised that he would help me
He promised he'd help me
He promised to help me
He promised me he would help me
He promised me that he'd help me
He promised he was going to help me

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Como "promised" está no passado, "will" vira "would": "He promised he would help me".
commonErrors.correction_en: He promised he would help me.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Use "promised to help" ou "promised he would help".
commonErrors.correction_en: He promised to help me.

exercises.sentence: She ___ us that the meeting was cancelled.
accepted: told

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Com a pessoa logo depois ("us"), usamos "told": "She told us". Ou "She said that..." sem "us".
commonErrors.correction_en: She told us that the meeting was cancelled.

exercises.instruction_pt: Which report is correct for: "Are you hungry?"
options: She asked if I was hungry.
She asked was I hungry if.
exercises.explanation_pt: Perguntas de sim ou não são reportadas com "if" ou "whether" e ordem de afirmação: "if I was hungry".

exercises.prompt: Apparently, she said it was the best trip of her life.
accepted: Apparently, she said it was the best trip of her life.

practice.instruction_pt: Repeat out loud.
practice.prompt: She told me she was moving to Lisbon next year.
accepted: She told me she was moving to Lisbon next year.

practice.instruction_pt: Repeat out loud.
practice.prompt: He asked me if I could cover his shift on Saturday.
accepted: He asked me if I could cover his shift on Saturday.
He asked me whether I could cover his shift on Saturday.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Na pergunta indireta a ordem é a de afirmação: "asked if I was", não "asked if was I".
commonErrors.correction_en: He asked me if I was coming.

practice.instruction_pt: Repeat out loud.
practice.prompt: My boss mentioned that the budget might be cut.
accepted: My boss mentioned that the budget might be cut.
My boss mentioned the budget might be cut.

practice.instruction_pt: Repeat. Stress "warned" and "not".
practice.prompt: They warned us not to take the night bus.
accepted: They warned us not to take the night bus.
They warned us not to take the bus at night.

practice.instruction_pt: Repeat out loud.
practice.prompt: Paul admitted he had forgotten about the meeting.
accepted: Paul admitted he had forgotten about the meeting.
Paul admitted that he'd forgotten about the meeting.

practice.instruction_pt: Repeat out loud.
practice.prompt: She wanted to know where I had bought my jacket.
accepted: She wanted to know where I had bought my jacket.
She wanted to know where I bought my jacket.

practice.example_en: She pointed out that the price didn't include taxes.
Apparently, the office is closing early on Friday.

practice.instruction_pt: Say it in English: "Ela me disse que estava cansada."
accepted: She told me she was tired
She told me that she was tired
She said she was tired
She said that she was tired
She said to me that she was tired
She told me she's tired
She said she's tired

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Say" não leva a pessoa logo depois. Use "told me" ou "said to me".
commonErrors.correction_en: She told me she was busy.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Tell" precisa da pessoa: "told me that...".
commonErrors.correction_en: She told me she was tired.

practice.instruction_pt: Say it in English: "Ele me perguntou se eu gostava do meu trabalho."
accepted: He asked me if I liked my job
He asked me whether I liked my job
He asked if I liked my job
He asked whether I liked my job
He asked me if I like my job
He asked me if I enjoyed my job

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Na pergunta indireta a ordem é a de afirmação: "asked if I was", não "asked if was I".
commonErrors.correction_en: He asked me if I was coming.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Para perguntas sim/não use só "if" ou "whether".
commonErrors.correction_en: He asked me if I liked my job.

practice.instruction_pt: Say it in English: "Meu médico me avisou para não comer muito sal."
accepted: My doctor warned me not to eat too much salt
My doctor warned me not to eat a lot of salt
My doctor told me not to eat too much salt
My doctor told me not to eat a lot of salt
My doctor warned me against eating too much salt
My doctor advised me not to eat too much salt

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Em ordens indiretas negativas o "not" vem antes do "to": "warned me not to eat".
commonErrors.correction_en: My doctor warned me not to eat too much salt.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Avisar para não fazer" é "warn someone not to". "Advise" é aconselhar.
commonErrors.correction_en: My doctor warned me not to eat too much salt.

practice.instruction_pt: Say it in English: "Ela admitiu que tinha cometido um erro."
accepted: She admitted she had made a mistake
She admitted that she had made a mistake
She admitted making a mistake
She admitted to making a mistake
She admitted she made a mistake
She admitted that she made a mistake
She admitted having made a mistake

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Cometer um erro" é "make a mistake" (passado "made").
commonErrors.correction_en: She admitted she had made a mistake.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Depois de "admit to" o verbo vai com -ing: "admitted to making".
commonErrors.correction_en: She admitted to making a mistake.

practice.instruction_pt: Say it in English: "Eles disseram que iam chegar atrasados."
accepted: They said they would be late
They said that they would be late
They said they were going to be late
They said they were going to arrive late
They told us they would be late
They said they would arrive late

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Say" não leva a pessoa logo depois. Use "told me" ou "said to me".
commonErrors.correction_en: She told me she was busy.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Para pessoas, "atrasado" é "late". "Delayed" se usa para voos e trens.
commonErrors.correction_en: They said they would be late.

practice.instruction_pt: Say it in English: "Ela quis saber onde eu morava."
accepted: She wanted to know where I lived
She asked me where I lived
She asked where I lived
She wanted to know where I live
She asked me where I live

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Na pergunta indireta a ordem é a de afirmação: "asked if I was", não "asked if was I".
commonErrors.correction_en: He asked me if I was coming.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Pergunta indireta: "where I lived", sem "did".
commonErrors.correction_en: She wanted to know where I lived.

practice.instruction_pt: Listen and report what Anna said. Start with "She said".
practice.listen: Anna: "I'm going to quit my job next month."
accepted: She said she was going to quit her job the next month
She said she was going to quit her job next month
She said she's going to quit her job next month
She said that she was going to quit her job next month
She told me she was going to quit her job next month
She said she would quit her job the following month

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Say" não leva a pessoa logo depois. Use "told me" ou "said to me".
commonErrors.correction_en: She told me she was busy.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: No discurso indireto o possessivo muda: "my" vira "her".
commonErrors.correction_en: She said she was going to quit her job next month.

practice.instruction_pt: Listen and report the question. Start with "He asked me".
practice.listen: Mark: "Do you want to come to the concert?"
accepted: He asked me if I wanted to come to the concert
He asked me whether I wanted to come to the concert
He asked me if I wanted to go to the concert
He asked me if I want to come to the concert
He asked me whether I wanted to go to the concert with him
He asked me if I wanted to go to the concert with him

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Na pergunta indireta a ordem é a de afirmação: "asked if I was", não "asked if was I".
commonErrors.correction_en: He asked me if I was coming.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Use "if" ou "whether" e a ordem normal: "asked me if I wanted".
commonErrors.correction_en: He asked me if I wanted to come to the concert.

practice.instruction_pt: Listen and report the warning. Use "warned".
practice.listen: Neighbour: "Don't leave your bike outside. It might get stolen."
accepted: She warned me not to leave my bike outside
He warned me not to leave my bike outside
My neighbour warned me not to leave my bike outside
My neighbor warned me not to leave my bike outside because it might get stolen
She warned me not to leave my bike outside because it might get stolen
My neighbour warned me that my bike might get stolen

commonErrors.explanation_pt: O "not" vem antes do "to": "warned me not to".
commonErrors.correction_en: My neighbour warned me not to leave my bike outside.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: No discurso indireto a ordem vira "not to" + verbo.
commonErrors.correction_en: My neighbour warned me not to leave my bike outside.

practice.instruction_pt: Listen and pass on the message to your colleague. Start with "Apparently".
practice.listen: Manager: "The meeting tomorrow has been cancelled."
accepted: Apparently, tomorrow's meeting has been cancelled
Apparently, the meeting tomorrow has been cancelled
Apparently, tomorrow's meeting was cancelled
Apparently, the meeting tomorrow was cancelled
Apparently, the meeting's been cancelled
Apparently, there is no meeting tomorrow

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Use o particípio: "has been cancelled".
commonErrors.correction_en: Apparently, tomorrow's meeting has been cancelled.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Cancel" na passiva: "has been cancelled".
commonErrors.correction_en: Apparently, tomorrow's meeting has been cancelled.

practice.instruction_pt: Choose the correct sentence.
options: He told me he was busy.
He said me he was busy.
practice.explanation_pt: "Tell" pede a pessoa (told me). "Say" não: "He said he was busy".

practice.instruction_pt: Choose the correct reported question.
options: She asked where the station was.
She asked where was the station.
She asked where is the station.
practice.explanation_pt: Na pergunta indireta, a ordem é sujeito + verbo: "where the station was".

practice.instruction_pt: Complete the sentence.
practice.sentence: My sister ___ me she had a new boyfriend.
accepted: told

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Com a pessoa logo depois, use "told": "told me".
commonErrors.correction_en: My sister told me she had a new boyfriend.

practice.instruction_pt: Complete the sentence.
practice.sentence: He asked me ___ I had finished the report.
accepted: if
whether

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Pergunta sim/não indireta: "if" ou "whether".
commonErrors.correction_en: He asked me if I had finished the report.

practice.instruction_pt: Put the words in order.
accepted: She asked me what time the train left

practice.instruction_pt: Match each expression to its meaning.
Role-play. Tell a friend what happened at work.
practice.scene_pt: Your friend Lucy asks about your day. Your manager gave you some news this morning.

turns.speaker: partner
turns.text: Hey! How was work today? You look a bit worried.

turns.speaker: you
turns.cue_pt: Diga que sua chefe te disse que a empresa estava mudando de escritório.
accepted: My boss told me the company was moving offices
My boss told me that the company was moving offices
My manager told me the company was moving to a new office
My boss said the company was moving offices
My boss told me the company's moving offices
My manager said that the company was moving to another office

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Say" não leva a pessoa logo depois. Use "told me" ou "said to me".
commonErrors.correction_en: She told me she was busy.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Chefe" no trabalho é "boss" ou "manager".
commonErrors.correction_en: My boss told me the company was moving offices.

turns.speaker: you
turns.cue_pt: Diga que ela mencionou que seria do outro lado da cidade.
accepted: She mentioned it would be on the other side of the city
She mentioned that it would be on the other side of town
She mentioned it was going to be on the other side of the city
She said it would be on the other side of town
She mentioned it would be across town
She mentioned it'd be on the other side of town

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Mention" não leva a pessoa logo depois: "she mentioned that..." ou "mentioned to me".
commonErrors.correction_en: She mentioned it would be on the other side of the city.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Do outro lado" é "on the other side".
commonErrors.correction_en: It would be on the other side of the city.

turns.speaker: partner
turns.text: That's far from your place! Did you ask her anything?

turns.speaker: you
turns.cue_pt: Diga que perguntou se vocês podiam trabalhar de casa alguns dias.
accepted: I asked if we could work from home some days
I asked her if we could work from home a few days a week
I asked her whether we could work from home some days
I asked if we could work from home on some days
I asked her if we could work remotely a few days a week

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Na pergunta indireta a ordem é a de afirmação: "asked if I was", não "asked if was I".
commonErrors.correction_en: He asked me if I was coming.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Para perguntas sim/não: "asked if" ou "asked whether".
commonErrors.correction_en: I asked her if we could work from home some days.

turns.speaker: you
turns.cue_pt: Diga que ela admitiu que ainda não tinha pensado nisso.
accepted: She admitted she hadn't thought about it yet
She admitted that she hadn't thought about it yet
She admitted she hadn't thought about that yet
She admitted she hadn't thought of it yet
She admitted she didn't think about it yet
She admitted she hadn't considered it yet

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Pensar em algo" é "think about" ou "think of".
commonErrors.correction_en: She admitted she hadn't thought about it yet.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Admit" não leva a pessoa logo depois.
commonErrors.correction_en: She admitted she hadn't thought about it yet.

practice.instruction_pt: Tell someone about a conversation you had recently.
practice.prompt_en: Think about an interesting conversation you had this week. What did the other person say and ask you?
guidelines_pt: Report questions: "He asked me if... / where..."
